blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Southwest Monsoon, locally known as Habagat, has officially ended, signaling a shift in the country’s prevailing weather pattern, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said Monday, October 5.
